description: 受管重启对象流：从 restart-intent 到 restart-outcome 的固定五节点 SESE 主链。准备阶段异步等待持久化回执，取消或超时保留原 owner。fresh start 仅在原 PID 已退出并核对交接后清理残留。admin_webui 是可选附属监听，业务端口负责发现。

nodes.notes: 上一发布代际交接只读取实例与 PID 控制真源；declaration.listeners 保持完整序列化（含 admin_webui），用于跨版本精确匹配，不在本节点拆分或丢弃监听声明。
把验证后的交接意图绑定到唯一 owner 与 nonce 化 restart plan；不发布监听，不评估端口可用性。

准备或拒绝 restart plan 时，端口可用性、占用端口采集、跨实例重叠释放与残留 PID/陈旧状态发现均只针对业务 listeners（server_id != "admin_webui"）；admin-only foreign PID 不会被发现、收割或被发送信号。declaration.listeners 仍完整保留 admin_webui 序列化；显式 PID 端口范围守卫只作用于业务目标端口集合。
借用式准备把 Server 完整控制记录的所有权放入既有 typed exec envelope，不删除原记录或关闭原控制传输。最终客户端核对后才 exec；拒绝或取消保留原 owner 和控制，释放准备守卫。业务端口发现仍排除 admin_webui。
验证原 managed owner 后显式交给 Server 接管；先启动业务 accept，再委托唯一写 owner Server 在共享期限内精确比较替换继承记录或清理退役地址。外来记录不动，失败显式写入启动结果并保留待清理责任。规范配置来自 declaration，与可选 Admin 无关；Admin 失败不回滚业务，业务端口冲突仍显式失败。

invariants: A failed terminal publication retains the old generation for formal recovery. Forced listener release authorizes managed disposition only after this invocation dispatches a signal successfully to the PID it just observed with matching live start token and complete declaration, cache and control. Verify original exit and unchanged witnesses before ordinary or exact terminal publication. Retain exact custody. For ordinary retirement settle the plan, socket, control and eligible hooks before the final cache. With all managed and transition proof absent, actual bare delivery permits publication. Without delivery return only a verified existing Stopped baseline and preserve it on disk.

Before Starting becomes durable, the fresh child rolls back only its successful publications. Once socket, cache and control are published, retire socket then control then cache. Stop rollback on the first failure and keep the original publication error.

Graceful Stopped and published Failed retire an abandoned plan only with matching generation and target before releasing its proof. A stopped business listener with unresolved plan cleanup reports incomplete shutdown to the public caller.

Native preparation publishes a typed target front before exec even when Server endpoint custody is empty. Interrupted old-handler and native adoption use the existing target front and retained generation link. Fresh start and formal restart verify both handoff locations before disposal. Predecessor control, front, status, plan and cache close before final target front removal. Normal adoption retains the front through readiness.

Fresh background and foreground launches preserve a matching Stopped baseline through log setup and spawn or exec. Only the fresh child publishes Starting after binding its managed socket and publishing its PID cache and matching control record.

Start, foreground start and formal restart share one cleanup decision. Before mutation, verify compatible declaration and status, complete generation and control identity, confirmed generation exit, the canonical socket leaf and free declared business ports. Preserve live, foreign, unreadable or contradictory resources. Terminal status alone grants no cleanup authority.

Ordinary stale cleanup requires settled transition and checkpoint custody and a durable matching terminal outcome. Publication failure retains all proof. Retire the verified socket, matching control, owned ancillary records and finally pid.cache. Complete independent dead proof remains usable after socket removal.

With matching terminal state and verified dead cache, confirmed absence of socket, control and unresolved transition custody permits only remaining local cleanup. A failed cache unlink remains selectable by formal restart. Exact and legacy recovery retain their own authority and target front through settlement.

A durable Failed status retains exact authority for an outstanding Provider checkpoint. Interrupted native adoption verifies unfinished predecessor state under its operation lock before endpoint retirement. Recovery disposes the checkpoint at its verified transition location and closes the matching transfer before retiring its independent predecessor proof.

Startup failure before or after Server construction, and readiness failure, publish Failed with the physical control disposition. Only durable Failed permits final settlement of the exact handoff and independent managed authority. An unresolved predecessor transition retains its proof in either directory for formal restart. Unrelated persistence stays bounded.

Failed adoption closes the verified predecessor control before reducing endpoint custody. Official restart selects exact exited handoff recovery before requiring target control metadata, from staged pre-adoption in either directory through predecessor control retirement. Any present status must match the declared instance. Independent generation proof authorizes retirement and bootstrap. Unresolved transitions preserve both proofs. Forced stop reports pending exact controls in its Stopped result.

A failed adoption retains actionable front and cache until the failure outcome is durable. In changed-directory recovery the locked predecessor generation must match any present control before endpoint retirement. Close its abandoned provider handoff before releasing predecessor authority so a subsequent formal restart may return to that declaration.

After same-directory declaration publication, fresh recovery reconciles a predecessor control record against the retained generation before retiring endpoints or removing the front artifact. A scoped forced stop retains independent generation proof for remaining exact custody.

The target front handoff carries exact Server custody through publication, readiness and terminal close. Before replacing predecessor evidence, the successor PID cache binds the verified predecessor generation (including nonce) to the target declaration. A fresh invocation verifies that link or the staged predecessor transition and process exit. Terminal close disposes controls before unrelated persistence waits and preserves the artifact and managed authority on unresolved disposition or failed reduction.
生命周期端口可用性、陈旧发现、跨实例释放与残留 PID 扫描仅针对业务 listeners（server_id != "admin_webui"）；admin-only foreign PID 永远不进入被接管、收割或信号范围。
run_managed_child_with_declaration 启动 Server aggregate 时，admin_webui 被视为可选附属监听：失败显式告警并跳过 admin router/background 注册，不回滚业务 listeners；业务 listener 真实端口冲突显式失败。
declaration.listeners 完整保留 admin_webui 序列化，维护 instance.json 与 PreviousReleaseRestartTransfer 的跨版本精确匹配；不得删除该条目来绕开发现范围问题。
命令区分发送控制前预算耗尽、控制交换超时和接受后等待新代超时。
显式 PID 端口范围守卫（guard_explicit_listener_pids_are_scoped_to_target_ports）原样保留，仅对业务目标端口集合允许显式 PID 信号收割。
